text: Added shared cross-domain MVPA primitives, CrossDomainClassifierAnalysis with naive correlation-centroid cross-decoding, single-ROI task and collector engine, README docs, and shared tests for analytic probabilities, searchlight plan preservation, distributed task boundary, sample-id-independent target scoring, feature permutation invariance, validation, and local ROI failures. Verified with sbt mvpaJVM/test mvpaJS/test and sbt testAll.
